diagnosis_candidates.description: The application configuration sets alerts.provider to 'email', but the only available implementation of NotificationSender is WebhookNotificationSender, which is conditionally registered only when alerts.provider is 'webhook'. This mismatch causes Spring to fail to find a NotificationSender bean, leading to an UnsatisfiedDependencyException when injecting it into NotificationService.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Update the alerts.provider property in application.yml to 'webhook' to match the available implementation, or provide an EmailNotificationSender implementation with a corresponding @ConditionalOnProperty for 'email'.
diagnosis_candidates.title: Mismatch between configured notification provider and available implementation
